name: FreeQR Micro-Constellation

monetization_doctrine: When users order a site in the future, Blocks build it (one-time or composable asset). The ongoing recurring value is the Constellation: customers subscribe to Stars operated autonomously by Titans.

Patrols 100% test passing rates, bundle size budgets, and synthetic uptime heartbeats.
